step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates high availability for an SAP Extended Warehouse Management deployment across two Availability Zones (AZs) using AWS. Users connect via an Alias pointing to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The architecture uses Overlay IPs configured in a VPC Route Table to maintain single static IP addresses that dynamically map to active nodes across AZs. The application tier consists of SAP ASCS and PAS in AZ1, with ERS and AAS in AZ2. The database tier consists of SAP HANA Primary in AZ1 replicating asynchronously/synchronously via HANA System Replication to SAP HANA Secondary in AZ2. In failover scenarios, cluster software uses AWS APIs to update VPC Route Table overlay IP entries to direct traffic to the active surviving nodes.
